text.excerpt: November turned out to be the right month — warm enough to sit outside, quiet enough to get a table.
text.intro: Five days, mostly walking, mostly eating. November turned out to be the right month for it: warm enough to sit outside in the evening, quiet enough that we never once waited for a table.
